title: Onboard zephyr-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation
author: Jordan Lee
description:
Add onboarding artifacts for zephyr-13b v1.0: canonical metadata, model bundle pointers, performance profiles for common instance classes, and CI automation to surface changelog entries automatically. Motivation: Zephyr is a new community LLM that we want available in the model catalog with verified perf profiles so customers can route to it from Redwood API and Dedicated.

Changes include: metadata.yaml (model metadata + safety tags), perf_profiles.json (latency/throughput profiles across representative hardware), a CHANGELOG template and generator integration, and tests/canary config.

Checklist:
- [x] Add model metadata and schema-compliant fields
- [x] Add benchmarked perf profiles (p99 latency, tokens/sec) for supported instance types
- [x] Wire changelog automation to model-registry CI to generate release notes on tag/publish
- [x] Update docs index (models catalog) with zephyr entry
- [x] Add unit & integration tests for metadata loader + perf profile validation

Notes: The perf numbers were generated with the perf-canary harness (runs attached) and reviewed with infra to confirm sample sizes. Changelog automation reuses existing templates used by previous onboarding PRs (see linked PRs).

release_notes: Onboard zephyr-13b v1.0: model metadata, validated performance profiles for supported instance types, and automated changelog generation for model releases. See models/zephyr/CHANGELOG.md for details.
changelog_automation: Added ci/model-registry/changelog-generator.yaml to generate model changelogs on publish
CHANGELOG.md.in template added so automation can populate release notes from perf metadata + manual entries
Automation includes checksum gating to prevent publishing stale changelogs
rationale: Provide a new model option in the catalog with vetted perf profiles and automated release notes so platform and customers can evaluate routing and cost tradeoffs without manual steps.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Perf profiles may not generalize to all instance types - mitigation: profiles are labeled with run config and we mark them as advisory for unsupported hardware.
Risk: Changelog automation could publish incorrect entries if metadata is stale - mitigation: checksum gating and CI validation test added.
Risk: Model safety tags may require updates post-onboarding - mitigation: doc points to safety-review flow and issue tracker link (ENG-3245).
